Class TUIInputReader

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am56.view.TUI.TUIInputReader
public class TUIInputReader extends Object
Reads user input from standard input for the TUI. It prints prompts and validates the input, re-prompting until a valid value is entered, and uses the TUIDrawer to print error messages.
